The ceremony took place at Purdue University in West Lafayette, as the tech giant is forging ahead with plans to establish its first next-generation High Bandwidth Memory production hub in the United States, with a total investment estimated at over $4 billion. title: SK hynix holds groundbreaking ceremony for HBM production base in US

description: A flash flood in a Nepalese valley near the Chinese border unleashed waves of devastation that inundated villages and swept away buildings, killing at least 389 and leaving more than 1,200 still missing, including hundreds of foreign tourists. Visitors from countries including India, Malaysia, Australia, the UK and US are unaccounted for more than 24 hours after the disaster, which washed away roads and bridges in Nepal’s mountainous Rasuwa district and prompted widespread evacuation alerts. title: Nepal flood death toll rises to 389 with 1,200 still missing

description: South Korea, the United States and Japan will conduct their trilateral military exercise off South Korea's southern coast early next month, the South's Joint Chiefs of Staff said Friday.
